author: Fixture Reporter
content:
The Justice Department has set a 30-day deadline for Nvidia to answer the formal information request in its inquiry into the Groq licensing arrangement. The deadline is a new procedural step following the request described in the earlier report.

The inquiry examines whether the structure of the December agreement sidestepped regulatory review. Groq described the technology license as nonexclusive, and its chief executive Jonathan Ross and chief operating officer Sunny Madra subsequently joined Nvidia.

The new deadline does not constitute a finding that the arrangement violated antitrust law. The investigation remains open while Nvidia prepares its response.
headline: DOJ Sets 30-Day Response Deadline In Nvidia–Groq Licensing Inquiry
summary: Investigators have given Nvidia 30 days to respond to the existing information request in the antitrust inquiry into its Groq arrangement.
